q: It always seems impossible until it is done.
If you talk to a man in a language he understands, that goes to his head. If you talk to him in his language, that goes to his heart.
A good head and a good heart are always a formidable combination.
I learned that courage was not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it.
Courageous people do not fear forgiving, for the sake of peace.
Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
You cannot carry out fundamental change without a certain amount of madness.
Until the lions have their own historians, the history of the hunt will always glorify the hunter.
Knowledge is power. Information is liberating.
It is the little things citizens do. That is what will make the difference.
Do your little bit of good where you are; it is those little bits of good put together that overwhelm the world.
I am not African because I was born in Africa, but because Africa was born in me.
If your dreams do not scare you, they are not big enough.
The single story creates stereotypes, and the problem with stereotypes is not that they are untrue, but that they are incomplete.
I am because we are.
If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
Smooth seas do not make skillful sailors.
Knowledge is like a garden: if it is not cultivated, it cannot be harvested.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
Let us never negotiate out of fear. But let us never fear to negotiate.
Never, for the sake of peace and quiet, deny your own experience or convictions.
Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
The price of greatness is responsibility.
Never doubt that a small group of thoughtful, committed citizens can change the world.
Seek first to understand, then to be understood.
A leader is best when people barely know he exists.
Leaders are people who do the right thing; managers are people who do things right.
Well done is better than well said.
Hope is the certainty that something makes sense, regardless of how it turns out.
The time is always right to do what is right.
Injustice anywhere is a threat to justice everywhere.
Peace cannot be kept by force; it can only be achieved by understanding.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
Do the best you can until you know better. Then when you know better, do better.
Real knowledge is to know the extent of one's ignorance.
For to be free is not merely to cast off one's chains, but to live in a way that respects and enhances the freedom of others.
